description: This file defines the ReviewerModel class, which is a data model used in the OrangeHRM performance plugin API. It maps a Reviewer entity to a normalized representation suitable for API responses, including serialization filters and attribute mappings.

classes.name: ReviewerModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing Reviewer entity data for API responses in the performance plugin.

methods.description: Initializes the ReviewerModel with a Reviewer entity, and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
